verdicts.reason: A keeps the product badge intact and the headline dominant, but every element is packed into the top ~60% and leaves a large empty orange band below. The NEW pill and Try It button sit in an awkward right column on a different axis from the headline, so the layout looks top-heavy and unfinished. B breaks the product graphic: the cream circle is detached and pushed into the bottom-left corner, and the orange can now blends into the orange background, leaving only a faint outline. B's headline is also small and weak, and the subcopy, CTA and NEW pill are scattered on unrelated axes, so its hierarchy and fidelity collapse.
